schema.description: Show all running entities (sessions, invocations, shows, plays) in a compact table, or drill into one entity by ID. Use --watch for live refresh.

chain.description: With --run: watch only the literal id(s) given, instead of following scheduler on_success/on_fail chain children by default.

entity_type.description: Filter table to a single entity type.

follow.description: With --run: keep watching for new schedule_runs after the initial set drains.

id.description: Entity ID (or prefix) to show detail view for. Omit for table view.

interval.description: Poll interval in seconds for --run mode (default 3). Independent of --refresh.

max_wait.description: With --run: give up waiting after this many seconds and exit EXIT_RUNNING for whatever is still pending, instead of blocking forever on a stuck session or run. Default: 900s. Pass 0 for unlimited.

project.description: Filter sessions and plays by project name.

run_ids.description: Wait for one or more schedule_run IDs to reach a terminal state, then exit (scripting primitive; see `li monitor run --help` for the positional form). Follows scheduler on_success/on_fail chain children by default (see --no-chain). Ignores id/--watch/--since/--type/--project.

since.description: Only show entities updated within this time window. Format: 30m, 1h, 2d (minutes/hours/days). Default: all running.

watch.description: Live-refresh the view every REFRESH seconds (default 2).

schema.title: monitor
